units.source_text: 我想，與其恐懼人類的「真實生活」，在每晚不眠的地獄呻吟，還不如待在牢獄裡舒服。

en.t: I thought that rather than fear humanity's "real life" and groan each sleepless night in hell, I would be more comfortable staying in prison.

units.source_text: 在櫻木町的別墅裡，父親忙於接待來客和外出辦事，即使同住一個屋簷下，也是三四天還見不上一面。

en.t: At the villa in Sakuragicho, my father was busy receiving visitors and going out on business, so even though we lived under the same roof, I might not see him for three or four days.

units.source_text: 雖然如此，父親的難以接近和我對他的恐懼感，總讓我想方設法搬出這個家到外面租房住。

en.t: Even so, my father's unapproachability and my fear of him kept making me look for some way to move out of this house and rent a room elsewhere.

units.source_text: 但我還沒來得及說出口，就從別墅的老管家那裡聽說父親打算賣掉這棟房子。

en.t: But before I could bring myself to say it, I heard from the old caretaker of the villa that my father intended to sell the house.

units.source_text: 父親的議員任期即將屆滿，加上其他種種理由，父親完全沒有繼續參選的意願。

en.t: My father's term as a legislator was about to expire, and for various other reasons as well, he had absolutely no intention of running again.
